notes.title: New Level For The Demo!
notes.content: [p]Due to the overwhelming amount of positive response we've received so far, we're adding an extra level along with some new post processing FX![/p][p][/p][p]The new level we added is ruins_02, it's the longest level in the demo and features elevators, keys and building to building parkour, here's a few screenshots:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332808/5cd40875b6cf30ed28f73ca7e3b7c0b6da2f8b11.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332808/7a83443fe3e04297dfa24b38eff74b457a538bb6.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332808/bc354164efe2a3b44f581a0047c54d00d80edb3d.png"][/img][/p][p]There's also a new Post Processing System that hints to you when you're in critical condition.[/p][p][/p][p]Hope you enjoy the new level! And before you leave, Steam gives games more visibility after 10 reviews so if you could leave a review, it would mean a lot to us![/p]

notes.title: Patch Update 0.7.3
notes.content: [p]We've made a few small changes after launch, the demo should be a much smoother experience.[/p][p][/p][p]Fixes:[/p][list][*][p]Player slide double jump glitch[/p][/*][*][p]Punch radius bug[/p][/*][*][p]R was mistaken for a reload a few times, the new button is P (this can be changed through rebindings)[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies sometimes not knocked down when too close[/p][/*][*][p]Stealing weapons off of enemies who weren't downed[/p][/*][*][p]Some tiny tweaks to sewer_02, sewer_03 and subway_01[/p][/*][*][p]Sniper shot time decreased[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thanks to everyone who has played and given us this feedback. And to anyone who enjoys the demo, PLEASE wishlist and leave a review. Steam gives games more visibility after 10 reviews so if you could, we would greatly appreciate it![/p]

notes.title: Get Ready for Adrenaline Overdrive
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 👋 We’re Rubicon Game Studios, an indie game dev team based in Dublin, Ireland, and we’re thrilled to introduce you to our next big project: [i]Adrenaline Overdrive[/i].

Step into the gritty, adrenaline-pumping world of an alternate 1980s Brooklyn. In this retro-styled first-person shooter, you’ll play as a detective on a deadly quest for justice, enhanced by experimental drugs that grant supernatural abilities—but at a cost.

[previewyoutube=HU5r78dXTlA;full][/previewyoutube]

[hr][/hr]

[h3]Why You’ll Love [i]Adrenaline Overdrive[/i]:[/h3]
[list]

[*][b]Retro FPS Action:[/b] Classic shooter gameplay fused with innovative modern mechanics.

[*][b]Supernatural Abilities:[/b] Leap, dash, and unleash powerful abilities as you uncover the truth.

[*][b]Engaging Storyline:[/b] A gripping tale of revenge, mystery, and the consequences of power.

[*][b]Atmospheric World:[/b] Explore a gritty, neon-lit alternate 1980s Brooklyn brought to life.

[*][b]Immersive Gameplay:[/b] Fast-paced combat and dynamic movement will keep you on edge.

[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332808/f565dbf8c56ee3408af89edac53a2728eba9c5c2.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]

[h3]Stay Connected:[/h3]
We’re working hard to bring [i]Adrenaline Overdrive[/i] to you in Q3 2025. Add the game to your [b]Wishlist[/b] today so you don’t miss any updates! And don’t forget to hop into the [b]Discussion Forums[/b] to share your thoughts or questions—we’d love to hear from you.

[b]Wishlist Now![/b] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3339570/Adrenaline_Overdrive/]Adrenaline Overdrive on Steam[/url]

[hr][/hr]

Thanks for joining us on this journey. Get ready to embrace the adrenaline rush—Brooklyn won’t wait for justice! 🔫🔥
